principle: Absence of evidence is FAIL, never not_evaluable. The previous programme's TPOT gate had two states, not_evaluable and pass, with no reachable fail; it stayed not_evaluable for the life of the project while the machine drifted 44,000x from target. A gate that cannot fail is a note. Every gate below reports FAIL until evidence says otherwise.

gates.statement: The integrated RTL produces the oracle's token IDs for the governed workload, on each of ROM and HBM, established compositionally over a closed verification ladder.
gates.fails_when: Any rung of the ladder fails, or the composition certificate does not bind every operator instance the workload issues to a rung that proved it.
gates.acceptance: G1a-G1f all pass, and results/rtl/abi3_g1_composition_certificate.json -- derived mechanically from G1e's issue trace, never asserted -- shows that every operator instance the governed workload issues falls in an equivalence class G1a proved bit-exact, that the layer loop is closed by G1b and G1c, that the emitted token ids equal results/abi3/qwen3_reference_oracle_eos.json, and that nothing outside the ladder was assumed.
does_not_establish: a single uninterrupted RTL execution of all 19 passes at full dimension: 143,889,104,896 MACs, 41.7 days at the measured integrated rate of 39,915 MACs/s, and lane width does not help (measured: 8 lanes deliver 1.14x lane-ops per CPU-second, because a cycle-accurate simulator's cost tracks evaluated logic times cycles). In industry that run happens on emulation at roughly 1-3 MHz or an FPGA prototype at 10-100 MHz, four to five orders of magnitude faster than software RTL simulation; this project has neither, and says so rather than pretending the pyramid is the same thing
dual-simulator agreement on the integrated path: it is Verilator-only by its own scope, and Icarus cannot run these cycle counts
TPOT or any rate -- that is gate G3
silicon behaviour: every rung is pre-silicon simulation against open PDKs

evaluator.note: REBUILT 2026-09-05 as a verification pyramid. The previous evaluator was artifact_field over results/rtl/*token*.json requiring only record.oracle.agreement == true, which any matching file would have satisfied; it was tightened the same day to a token_record evaluator, and is now replaced outright because the measurement it was tightened against showed the run it demanded costs 41.7 days per storage class. Simulating a whole network is not how an accelerator is verified. The pyramid is: bit-exact reference-model equivalence per operator class (G1a), layer closure (G1b), an RTL-to-RTL inductive step plus the loop property (G1c), an RTL-emitted token (G1d), the whole workload's control path with engine results injected at the boundary (G1e), and a complete unassisted run at reduced dimension (G1f) -- then a mechanically derived certificate composing them. Total measured cost about 6.8 h sequential per store, roughly 3 h wall with the independent legs concurrent, against 41.7 days for the run this replaces. It is a HARDER gate to satisfy than the one it replaces, not an easier one: six falsifiable rungs and a certificate, versus one boolean in one file.

gates.statement: Every operator equivalence class the governed decode program issues executes in the integrated RTL, from the real compiled program against the real checkpoint weights, and matches the golden model bit for bit.
gates.fails_when: Any issued class is uncovered, any word differs, any family is still trapped as CAPABILITY, or the weights are not the real checkpoint.

evaluator.note: Rung of the RTL verification ladder (docs/CHIP_ARCHITECTURE_DESIGN.md section 11.5). Every rung carries the same provenance spine: a named simulator, a positive simulated_cycles, an evidence_class naming RTL simulation, and a clean worktree, for EACH of rom and hbm. This is the base of the pyramid: bit-exact reference-model equivalence per (family, shape, numeric contract) class, which is what makes composition sound. Cost is bounded by the largest single operator, not by the network.

gates.statement: One complete transformer layer executes end to end in the integrated RTL, bit-exact against the golden model at every intermediate, with no golden value injected inside the layer.
gates.fails_when: The layer is incomplete, any intermediate differs, or any intermediate was injected from the golden model.

evaluator.note: Rung of the RTL verification ladder (docs/CHIP_ARCHITECTURE_DESIGN.md section 11.5). Every rung carries the same provenance spine: a named simulator, a positive simulated_cycles, an evidence_class naming RTL simulation, and a clean worktree, for EACH of rom and hbm. 192,937,984 MACs = 1.34 h per store at the measured integrated rate of 39,915 MACs/s. This rung proves the operator SEQUENCE within a layer, the residual plumbing, the KV write and read, and the buffer handoff -- the things a per-operator campaign cannot see.

gates.statement: Two consecutive layers execute back to back with an RTL-to-RTL handoff, and the loop control issues exactly the model's layer count of structurally identical invocations.
gates.fails_when: Any golden value crosses the layer boundary, the handoff differs, or the loop issues a different count or a non-identical invocation.

evaluator.note: Rung of the RTL verification ladder (docs/CHIP_ARCHITECTURE_DESIGN.md section 11.5). Every rung carries the same provenance spine: a named simulator, a positive simulated_cycles, an evidence_class naming RTL simulation, and a clean worktree, for EACH of rom and hbm. 2.69 h per store. This is the inductive step: G1b is the base case, this is layer N to layer N+1, and the loop property closes the induction over all 36 layers. Assume-guarantee reasoning, not extrapolation -- the loop count and the structural identity of the invocations are both mechanically checked, not asserted.

gates.statement: The final normalisation, the LM head and argmax execute in the integrated RTL on the composed trunk output and emit the oracle's first generated token id, on each of ROM and HBM.
gates.fails_when: The emitted id differs from the oracle's, or the head was not executed in RTL.

evaluator.note: Rung of the RTL verification ladder (docs/CHIP_ARCHITECTURE_DESIGN.md section 11.5). Every rung carries the same provenance spine: a named simulator, a positive simulated_cycles, an evidence_class naming RTL simulation, and a clean worktree, for EACH of rom and hbm. 622,329,856 MACs; 4.33 h whole, or 1.08 h wall in four concurrent row shards, which is how the chip itself computes it. This rung is where an RTL-emitted token id first exists.

gates.statement: All 19 passes of the governed workload execute through the real RTL control plane, with engine results injected only at the engine boundary, and the RTL issue trace equals the golden model's element for element; OFFICIAL_EOS is raised and the post-EOS instruction refused.
gates.fails_when: The traces diverge at any index, the pass count differs, EOS is not raised, the post-EOS instruction is admitted, or the control path was not the RTL's.

evaluator.note: Rung of the RTL verification ladder (docs/CHIP_ARCHITECTURE_DESIGN.md section 11.5). Every rung carries the same provenance spine: a named simulator, a positive simulated_cycles, an evidence_class naming RTL simulation, and a clean worktree, for EACH of rom and hbm. ~3 h per store: the control plane is 0.3% of integrated cycles, so the whole workload's CONTROL is affordable even though its arithmetic is not. This is standard hybrid co-simulation -- the real sequencer fetches, decodes, resolves views, checks predicates, drives the loop and issues, while the datapath results come from the model whose bit-exactness G1a-G1d establish. It is the factor usually hand-waved in a composition argument, and it is checked here element for element.

gates.statement: The complete workload -- prefill, every layer, all generated tokens, EOS and the post-EOS refusal -- executes end to end in the RTL with nothing injected, on a structurally identical model at reduced dimension, and emits that model's oracle tokens.
gates.fails_when: Any operation is injected from the golden model, the reduced configuration is not structurally identical to the full one, or the emitted ids differ from the reduced oracle's.

evaluator.note: Rung of the RTL verification ladder (docs/CHIP_ARCHITECTURE_DESIGN.md section 11.5). Every rung carries the same provenance spine: a named simulator, a positive simulated_cycles, an evidence_class naming RTL simulation, and a clean worktree, for EACH of rom and hbm. Minutes. The industry's small-config regression: the tapeout configuration is verified by the pyramid, the regression configuration is run whole, nightly. It establishes control flow, composition and token emission with nothing supplied; it does NOT establish numerics at full dimension, which is what G1a-G1d are for. Its oracle is the same reference implementation at the reduced configuration.

gates.statement: A routed netlist exists containing the datapath array, the memory system AND the microsequencer, at one named PDK, with DRC 0 and antenna 0.
gates.fails_when: Any block of the ABI 3.0 control plane is absent from the physical results.

evaluator.note: The first evaluator passed when any routed block's directory was NAMED microsequencer / sequencer / control_plane / descriptor, so the day the microsequencer's front end was routed on its own (results/physical_abi3/asap7/a3_microsequencer/pnr.json, 2026-09-05: ot_a3_microsequencer at STATE_COMPAT = 0, no descriptor store, no dependence table, no engine, no memory macro) this terminal gate would have gone green on a third of its statement -- the G4 defect of 7df5d51 again. It now reads each pnr.json and passes only when ONE record's sources cover the microsequencer and the datapath array (the vehicle's array is T64 = 8 x LQ8, docs/CHIP_ARCHITECTURE_DESIGN.md section 11.1, so an LQ8 or a tile64 source counts), the memory system is present as placed macros (the vehicle memories are macro abstracts, section 11.2; every record to date has macro_count 0), and the route is clean (DRC 0, antenna 0). The front-end record alone therefore fails, and the failure names what it lacks.

gates.statement: Measured TPOT against a FROZEN per-model budget, composed from RTL-measured cycles over the issue trace G1 certified.
gates.fails_when: TPOT exceeds the budget, no budget is frozen, the cycles are not RTL-measured, or the trace is not certified by G1.

evaluator.note: This is the gate the previous programme could not fail. Its first evaluator searched configs/**/*.json for the string tpot_acceptance and passed on finding its own specification file -- a budget gate passing on its own definition, which is the not_evaluable gate in a new costume. It now reads a budget file with numeric per-row budgets and measurement records under results/tpot/, and every row must have BOTH a budget and a correctness-qualified measurement inside tolerance. A null budget is a FAIL. A missing measurement is a FAIL. RESTATED 2026-09-05: this gate said 'on a run that first passed G1', and G1's own feasibility measurement showed that run costs 41.7 days per storage class. A budget gate whose measurement cannot exist is the not_evaluable defect wearing a stopwatch. TPOT is now composed from RTL-measured per-operator and per-boundary cycles over the certified issue trace, which is both achievable and harder to fake.

gates.statement: The cycle model reproduces the measured block cycles of the RTL within a stated band, and the derived machine reproduces the analytical design point.

evaluator.note: G4 has two halves: the cycle model reproduces the RTL's measured block cycles within the stated band (docs/CHIP_ARCHITECTURE_DESIGN.md section 11.5, L3: +/-10 percent, boundary 120 cycles), AND the derived machine reproduces the analytical design point. The regime half already has its own gate, C3, and passed there once its field path was corrected. For one commit this gate passed on C3's artifact alone -- half its statement -- which is the not_evaluable defect in miniature; it now reads the L3 calibration artifact, which does not exist yet, and fails until it does. The artifact is produced when tools/derive_cycle_machine.py is re-parameterised from the L1 block-cycle records (results/rtl/abi3_pipelined_lane.json and successors). reason_field: when the artifact exists and its verdict is false, the board shows the artifact's own reason (the boundary ratio, the unmeasured control plane) rather than the absence text.

gates.statement: The new datapath equals the existing sequential lane bit for bit over the swept space.
Measured MAC per lane per cycle is at least 1.0.
gates.fails_when: The lane does not reach it.

evaluator.note: The present lane is 0.2 by its own header, and the matmul engine 0.34588/2 = 0.173.

gates.statement: The synthesised netlist contains N lanes for a declared N.
gates.fails_when: The netlist has one lane while the capability advertises more.

evaluator.note: design.lanes is the declared LANES parameter; design.lanes_verified_in_netlist is set by tools/run_abi3_physical.py only when the same number of distinct lane prefixes is recovered from the routed netlist's instance names (--lane-instance-regex), so a declared count the netlist does not contain cannot pass.

gates.statement: Per-MAC area and per-MAC period both improve against the recorded matmul_bf16_sram_engine baseline at the same PDK.

evaluator.baseline_note: The baseline record predates the design block, so its per-MAC figures are derived from its routed record: 0.17294 MAC per cycle is the matmul engine's measured 0.34588 lane-ops per two cycles (gate D2 note; docs/PERFORMANCE_DESIGN_POSTMORTEM.md), giving 8,348.44 um2 / 0.17294 = 48,274 um2 per MAC/cycle and 18 ns / 0.17294 = 104.1 ns per MAC, the figures docs/CHIP_ARCHITECTURE_DESIGN.md section 8.4 cites. A candidate must be a closed routed result (status pass, design.closed true) at the baseline's view and must declare design.per_mac_area_um2 and design.per_mac_period_ns itself. The baseline record predates the signal-integrity fields and its container report is not retained, so it carries closed=false with that reason; its closure was never a premise of this gate -- the comparison is against a CANDIDATE that closes clean, and the baseline's figures are what its routed metrics record.
evaluator.note: Per-MAC figures are the node-portable ones. METHODOLOGY section 9 forbids scaling any absolute figure across nodes.

gates.statement: Every preserved failure mode still traps distinctly.
ROM and HBM machines come from one derivation and differ only inside a cited weight-path allowlist.
gates.fails_when: Any parameter outside the allowlist differs.

gates.statement: The compiled deployments hand neither side an advantage in tile shape, column group, tile depth or DMA tile count.

evaluator.note: The shipped comparison handed ROM a 2x tensor-lane advantage and a 16x column-group advantage. The audit (tools/derive_cycle_machine.py audit_deployments) compares, per engine family and per operator, every SCHEDULE field runtime.cycle.model.tile_mapping reads -- tile_rows, tile_cols, tile_depth, issue_window, max_outstanding, queue_index, bank_mask, port_mask, noc_route_class -- with the tile counts, padding and DMA bytes per tile they produce for the same useful work, the direction each difference favours, and the tensor parity band for the pair's actual tile depths. A cell with no compiled deployment pair reports comparable = false with reason 'no deployment built'. The gate reads deployment_audit.verdict as the failure reason. require_all: every derived pair's audit must say comparable, not the first that does; the C2 audit's verifier established that a first-match pass would go green the day one re-emitted pair is comparable while fourteen are not.

gates.statement: The cycle model and the analytical model find the same binding constraint.

evaluator.note: Same path correction as G4. The ROM regime match is the informative half; the HBM match is attribution-defined. A reconciliation where either target disagrees with the analytical binding constraint fails this gate.

gates.statement: No published run sits more than 100x above its own bandwidth floor.

evaluator.note: A 260,846,119,253-cycle run once sat 11,558x above its own floor at 0.02% bandwidth utilisation and was read as a per-token latency. This gate reads the derived-machine run records under results/derived/ (every one written by tools/run_abi3_cycle.py after 1b71dff carries plausibility.* and inputs.cycle_model). The 26 records under results/abi3/cycle/ predate the floor and are retained by the post-mortem as evidence of a failure, not as performance figures; they are out of this gate's scope by design, and any new performance claim must come from a run that states its own floor. Absence of a derived run record is a FAIL.
